description: Pull recent audience comments (Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook Pages) and Google Business Profile reviews into the Unified Inbox (Studio and Pro). Respects a 5-minute cooldown per account and arms automatic 6-hour background refreshes.

accountId.description: Optional account id from accounts_list to sync one connected account; omit to sync all eligible connected accounts.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: inbox_sync
title: Sync comments and reviews
